text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_screen_round3","campaign_class":"composition_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"confirm current plate id before deposition"},{"server":"deposition_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"NiFeCoSn baseline film, standard thickness"},{"server":"furnace_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":780,"duration":240,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard crystallization step per SOP-ANN-2; temperature within routine window"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2 for OER overpotential"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,40,0,10,0,0]},"comment":"log overpotential point"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"objective":"min_overpotential"},"comment":"refresh GP surrogate with new point"}]}
